covered_report_window.plain_language: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Tuesday, October 13, 2026 U.S. market close and before the Wednesday, October 14, 2026 U.S. market open.

market_context_summary: The S&P 500 is near record highs but the tape is mixed, semiconductors are under pressure, big-bank results were strong but uneven, and September CPI is due before Wednesday's open alongside the earnings releases.

methodology.consensus_rule: Arithmetic mean of Pass A, Pass B, and Pass C direction scores and reversal-risk values.
methodology.disparity_rule: Rounded root-mean-square dispersion of the three direction scores and three reversal-risk values around their respective means, on a 0-100 scale.
methodology.lessons_review: No new method change. Existing priced-in penalties were applied to ASML and FAST, and the smaller-company hidden-risk check was applied to AZZ.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Positive fee, NII, flow, and estimate-revision momentum at a moderate valuation gives STT the cleanest upside setup.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $3.65-$3.68; investors are focused on servicing and management fees, NII, and positive operating leverage.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Continued fee growth, firm NII, record asset levels, and controlled expenses extend operating leverage.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A market-driven fee slowdown or faster expense growth breaks the operating-leverage story.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options implied move about 5.2%; ten-year average earnings-day peak move about 6.6%.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus EPS was revised marginally higher in the final week; the most-accurate estimate was above consensus.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Metal Coatings margin and FY2027 guide
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Precoat softness or no second raise
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record segment sales and a prior guidance raise support upside if Metal Coatings margins hold and management validates the higher FY2027 range.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly $1.86-$1.87 EPS and $468 million revenue; options price an unusually large move.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Another clean sales beat, 30% area Metal Coatings margin, and guidance validation or lift.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Precoat volume/mix weakness, capex pressure, or merely reiterating a bar already raised in July.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Third-party options estimate about 9.1%, making magnitude harder to clear even with an upside print.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public consensus clustered tightly around $1.86-$1.87 EPS; detailed revision breadth was unavailable.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Net inflows and organic base-fee growth
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record AUM and strong ETF-led flows favor another constructive report, provided fee-rate and margin conversion remain intact.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $14.30 EPS and $7.44 billion revenue; the market is likely to look through EPS toward flows and organic base-fee growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Strong long-term flows, better private-market fundraising, and margin leverage validate durable growth.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: AUM rises mainly from markets while organic fee growth or operating margin disappoints.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options implied move about 4.8%, modestly above the ten-year average of 4.3%.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: EPS estimates rose about 0.3% over 30 days while revenue estimates slipped about 0.5%.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-10-14 before open, materials at 6:00 a.m. CT
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong sales are visible, but a premium multiple leaves the stock vulnerable if price-cost and customer mix keep gross margin under pressure.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is $0.34; August daily sales rose 16.6%, so margin conversion rather than volume alone is the bar.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Pricing catches up, gross margin stabilizes, and operating leverage converts robust manufacturing demand into an EPS beat.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Gross-margin compression and weak cash conversion make an in-line EPS print look low quality.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options implied move about 6.0%, near the ten-year average of 6.4%; short interest is modest.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus is Hold-leaning in available public data; recent earnings history has mostly met rather than beaten EPS expectations.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Raised bar, China risk, softer forward tone
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI-linked EUV demand and a raised outlook support upside, but the valuation and forward-expectation bar make a solid quarter vulnerable to sell-the-news action.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $12.1 EPS and $13.2 billion revenue; company Q3 guidance is EUR11-EUR12 billion sales and 55%-57% gross margin.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: High-NA/EUV shipment commentary and 2027 visibility extend the AI-capex cycle beyond the current raised guide.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A merely in-line quarter, softer 2027 tone, or China/export restrictions overwhelm headline strength.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 6.1%, slightly above the long-run average; the stock entered the event at a demanding growth multiple.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analyst stance remains broadly bullish, but the stock needs forward validation after a major rerating.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Equities trading and wealth net new assets
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Post-Q2 normalization and high whisper bar
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong trading comps and wealth inflows provide modest upside, but falling estimates and an exceptional Q2 make the hurdle hard to judge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $2.94 EPS and $19.96 billion revenue; EPS and revenue estimates fell 6.5% and 3.5% over 30 days.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Goldman-like equities strength plus resilient investment banking and wealth flows produce another clear beat.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Trading normalizes faster than expected and wealth margins or net new assets cool from Q2 records.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 4.5%, close to the ten-year average of 4.6%.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent estimate cuts lower the bar but also signal expected deceleration; the most-accurate estimate was below consensus.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Easy September comp and low valuation
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: July-August earnings lagged last year and the combined ratio worsened, but an easy September comparison and low valuation erase a reliable edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is roughly $4.30-$4.38; September must contribute about $1.17 per share to top the prior-year Q3.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: September underwriting rebounds against a weak prior-year month while policy growth remains healthy.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Combined-ratio deterioration persists and shows pricing is no longer outrunning loss costs.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Reliable event-specific implied-move data was unavailable; the stock trades near 11 times trailing earnings.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public estimates cluster around $4.3-$4.4; detailed revision breadth was unavailable.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Q2 NII and credit were sound, but downward estimate revisions and mixed peer results leave no clean directional edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.10-$1.11 EPS and $30.6 billion revenue; NII and card charge-offs matter more than headline EPS.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: NII beats, deposits remain stable, and consumer charge-offs improve enough to trigger a value rerating.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Loan growth stays soft, expense guidance rises, or consumer credit weakens despite a headline beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 4.0%; recent realized earnings moves averaged roughly 2.2%-3.9% depending on lookback.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: JPMorgan cut its Q3 EPS estimate to $1.12 from $1.16; ten analysts reportedly revised upcoming earnings downward.
